premium.title: Premium
premium.intro: Enzanisa Yemahara uye Premium. Mushure mekubhadhara, tumira referensi yako yekubhadhara kwatiri - admin anovhura account yako.
premium.introAdmin: Yemahara vs Premium matrix yeiyi app. Rongedza kuti ndezvipi zvekuwedzera zveMahara kana Premium mu Admin → Premium. Yako admin account inotosanganisira Premium.
premium.introMember: Chirongwa chako chePrimiyamu chiri kushanda. Hezvino izvo Mahara vs Premium inosanganisirwa pane iyi app.
premium.howBody:
1) Bhadhara iyo Premium mari. 
2) Isa yako UPI / bank transaction reference. 
3) Tumira chikumbiro - inovhura email kune yedu rutsigiro rweGmail. 
4) Admin anosimbisa kubhadhara uye anobatidza Premium kuaccount yako.
premium.payHint: Bhadhara {price}, wobva waisa dhizaini / UTR referensi pazasi. Isu tinotumira email {email} kuitira kuti admin agone kumisa Premium.
premium.upiMissing: UPI mubhadharo haisati yagadzirwa. Bhadhara nemaitiro ako enguva dzose, wozotumira referensi yekutengeserana.
premium.upiOpenFailed: Hatina kukwanisa kuvhura UPI app. Bhadhara nemaoko, wozotumira referensi yako yekutengeserana.
premium.refRequired: Isa referensi yako yekubhadhara (angangoita mavara mana).
premium.requestSent: Email draft yakavhurwa. Itumire, wobva wamirira admin kuti avhure Premium kuaccount yako.
premium.adminIncluded: Admin maakaundi anosanganisira Premium. Akasarudzika mavara uye gore sync zvakavhurwa iwe.
premium.signInFirst: Pinda kuti ukumbire Premium. Inovhura chete mushure mekunge kubhadhara kwasimbiswa na admin.

settings.title: App Settings
settings.restoreWarnBody:
Ngenisa zvigadziriso zvemafambisirwo uye mabhajeti chete ehuwandu hwemazuva mufaira. Data iri kunze kweiyo range iri pafoni iyi inoramba iripo. 

Maakaundi: anodzoserwa kubva mufaira chete kana foni iyi isati yaita zvekutengesa (semuenzaniso mushure mekuiswazve). Zvikasadaro maakaundi ako azvino anogara. 

Iwe unozobvunzwa kana uchitsiva zviyeuchidzo uye rondedzero yekutenga. 

Kana Premium gore sync iripo, iyo yakasanganiswa mhedzisiro inowirirana (yekupedzisira ~ makore maviri mugore).
settings.restoreConfirmBody: Gadziridza mabatirwo uye mabhajeti emazuva ekuchengetedza parunhare urwu? Data kunze kweiyo renji ichachengetwa.
settings.restoreRemindersBody: Dzorera zviyeuchidzo uye rondedzero yekutenga kubva pane iyi backup? Sarudza Chengeta kuti usiye dziri parunhare urwu.
settings.restoredOk: Backup yaunzwa. Kutengeserana/mabhajeti ari mufaira remazuva akagadziridzwa; mamwe mazuva pafoni iyi akachengetwa.
settings.restoreFailed: Iro faira haritaridzike seanoshanda Pulse Wallet backup.
settings.restorePremiumOnly: Kudzoreredza faira rekuchengetedza chinhu chePrimum. Vhura Premium kushandisa Backup / Dzosera.

import.title: Kupinza matransaction
import.lead: Skena kubhengi kana kuodha mameseji, namira mavara, kana batanidza skrini. Wongorora machisi usati wachengeta - hapana chinowedzerwa otomatiki.
import.leadAuto: Pulse Wallet inoverenga kiredhiti yako yebhangi uye dhibhiti yeSMS parunhare urwu, inovafananidza nemitemo, yobva yakuita kuti uwedzere semubhadharo kana mari mupombi imwe chete.
import.smsHint: Tinoverenga inbox kubva mazuva {days} adarika pafoni iyi. Mameseji haambosiye mudziyo.
import.smsHintAuto: Tinotarisisa mazuva {days} ekupedzisira eSMS eUPI / makiredhiti ekubhangi uye mabhengi. Hapana chinochengetwa kusvika wasimbisa pazasi.
import.smsIos: iOS apps haigoni kuverenga SMS. Kupinza otomatiki ndeye Android-chete.
import.smsNeedBuild: Ichi chakaiswa chivakwa cheapp hachikwanisi kuverenga SMS parizvino.
import.smsNeedBuildDetail: Yako yazvino APK yakavakwa isati yawedzerwa kuverenga kweSMS. Expo Go zvakare haigone kuverenga SMS. Iyo app inofanirwa kuvakwa patsva uye kuisirwazve kuitira kuti ivhure inbox uye kugadzira kutengeserana kubva kukiredhiti / kubhengi mameseji.
import.smsNeedBuildAction: Bvunza iyo nyowani yekuvandudza Android kuvaka, isa iyo APK, wobva wavhura Import zvakare - ichaongorora SMS otomatiki.
import.smsEmpty: Hapana inoenderana nechikwereti/yekubhengi SMS yawanikwa yemitemo inoshanda.
import.pasteHint: Nama meseji imwe, kana akati wandei akapatsanurwa nemutsara usina chinhu.
import.pasteEmpty: Hatina kukwanisa kupatsanura huwandu kubva pane zvakanamirwa.
import.shotHint: Sarudza odha kana yekubhadhara skrini, wobva waisa mavara akakopwa neMapikicha / Lens (kana kunyora iwo). Mufananidzo wacho unogona kubatanidza semufananidzo webhiri.
import.ocrEmpty: Hatina kukwanisa kupatsanura mari kubva pamavara epikicha.
import.noRules: Hapana mitemo yekutenga kunze inogoneswa. Kumbira admin kuti abatidze mitemo.
